messages:
marta: Quick thread to align on rollout for the new routing fallback feature. goal: staged regions + tiny slices + paired A/B checks. propose explicit kill-switch and auto-throttle rules.
sean: agree. suggest three fallbacks: cache -> quantized model -> remote proxy. each fallback tracked separately in metrics.
jess: for quality gating we should run paired A/B on a 1k prompt set per step. metric: top1 exact match and latency p95. require bootstrap CI and p < 0.05 for go.
rishi: traffic plan idea: dev 2% -> beta 8% -> invited customers 25% -> public 35% -> full. min dwell 24h, hold longer if gate unstable.
emily: ops: do regional canaries: NA+EU first (avoid rolling during peaks), APAC after NA/EU clear. dashboards + synthetic path required.
marta: draft flag snippet (for ops to consume):
```yaml
flag: routing_fallback_v3
variants: [control, staged_fallback]
steps: [dev, beta, invited, public]
```
sean: automated rollback rules: error_rate > 3x baseline over 15m OR latency_p99 breach -> throttle back and page. also cost-per-request > +40% -> hold.
jess: I'll own paired-eval pipeline. will publish daily report to #product-canaries during canary windows.
emily: ops will add synth check `scripts/synth_route_check.sh` every 2m and keep 7d logs for canary users. set alert: synth failures > 3 in 15m -> page.
rishi: deploy-bot: scheduled NA canary 2026-06-01 09:00 PDT (48h), EU 2026-06-01 15:00 UTC (48h). APAC start after NA+EU clear. checklist posted. :spiral_calendar_pad:
marta: next steps: owners = @sean (metrics), @jess (tests), @emily (ops), @rishi (deploy). schedule 1h shiproom 24h before public ramp. tagging this thread as rollout source of truth. :white_check_mark:
